title: Fix state shared between shopping carts
instruction:
cart.py has a bug: separate Cart objects interfere with each other, and merge_carts leaks results between calls. Fix it.

Each Cart must have its own independent list of items. Cart.add(name, qty=1) appends (name, qty). Cart.total_quantity() returns the sum of quantities.

merge_carts(a, b) must return a new list containing a's items followed by b's items. It must not modify a or b, and each call must return a fresh list that is independent of every earlier call. Keep the existing function and method names. Do not edit test_cart.py.
